summary: The main article describes a photocatalytic synthesis of functionalized γ-lactams using amines, alkenes, and impure CO2 (exhaust gas). It includes optimization tables, substrate scope figures for amines and alkenes, late-stage functionalization of bioactive molecules, and mechanistic studies.

items.heading: Fig. 1
items.caption: Strategies for the construction of γ -lactam core. LSF late-stage functionalization, PC photocatalyst, SET single electron transfer; a selected bioactive molecules containing functionalized γ -lactam core; b existing strategies for the synthesis of γ -lactams; c existing strategy for the synthesis of γ -lactams using CO2 as an activator; d overview of this work.
items.description: This figure provides context for the research by showing bioactive molecules with γ-lactam cores and comparing the current work to existing synthetic strategies.
